description: Provenance manifest pairing every canonical BDF reference artifact in this directory with the raw vendor export it was generated from. See README.md and the Reference Datasets documentation page.
column_key_convention: Machine-readable notation from the BDF ontology (e.g. test_time_second); one key per quantity with the canonical unit baked in. See https://battery-data-alliance.github.io/battery-data-format-ontology/pages/specification.html

datasets.deliberate_data_bugs: Contains physically implausible voltage outlier spikes exactly as logged by the instrument. Kept on purpose to demonstrate outlier repair with bdf.clean. The same instrument glitches corrupt the vendor energy accumulators: the net-energy identity is violated by up to 15.5 Wh and the charging/discharging energy columns are non-monotonic, exactly as exported.

Pulse test, sodium-ion cell, 25 degC. Arbin accumulator columns (Charge/Discharge Capacity and Energy) are deliberately absent: their reset points are schedule-authored (verified: resets at scripted steps 9/12/74, cycle index constant), so no test-accumulating BDF term is correct in general. They will return via derivation from current x time.

unconverted_raw_files.reason: Converts cleanly with the basytec_txt plugin, but the 258 MB raw yields a 58 MB BDF CSV — larger than we commit to the repository. Regenerate locally with scripts/generate_zenodo_reference_bdf.py if needed.
